correctness.rationale: The three-chord distribution has full support with exact masses 1/3, 2/15, 1/15, 1/15 by edge count and satisfies both classes of Boolean elementary squares. Four-chord exact graph masses are 2/15, 2/45, 2/45, 4/315 and give FKG ratio 6/7. The proof of MTP2 closure under a single Boolean marginal is explicit, with cross-term inequality and zero-case treatment, then iterates. Independent chord projectivity transfers the four-chord obstruction to every larger diagram; positive edge-activity tilts cancel in lattice ratios. For shared chord crossing events the conditional beta integral gives covariance 1/45; disjoint chord pairs are independent. Two exact exhaustive finite generators agree through five chords, without replacing the all-size proof.

value.rationale: The FKG lattice condition is a standard structural route to inequalities for increasing observables. A sharp n=3 versus n=4 complete classification for the natural random circle-graph edge law, preserved under arbitrary positive edge activities, is a mathematically motivated boundary with implications for using FKG methodology. Pairwise crossing covariances are nonnegative even in the non-MTP2 regime, so single-edge correlations do not resolve the issue. The result is limited to MTP2 and does not claim an increasing-event covariance counterexample.
